references.text: The Lord promises to bless the fruit of the womb, the produce of the land, and the livestock in the land he swore to give to the fathers.
The same promise of blessing over the fruit of the womb, the produce of the land, and the livestock as part of the covenant promises.
The Lord will bring abundance in the fruit of the womb, in the increase of the livestock, and in the produce of the land when the people turn to him.
God's oath to Abraham to give his descendants the land, which is the foundation of the promise in Deuteronomy.
God's promise to Isaac to give the land to his descendants, a confirmation of the oath to the fathers.
The Lord promises blessing over bread, water, and fertility when Israel serves him.
The Lord promises to make the people fruitful and numerous when they keep his commands.
The proverb that the Lord blesses the house of the righteous, including material abundance.
